# AT30

> AT30 is a browser-based platform for seasonal multiplayer events, games, and hosted company experiences. AT30 Digital Museum is Experience 001, the platform's first live world and MVP.

## Canonical pages
- [AT30 platform and current experience](https://at30.io/)
- [Privacy policy](https://at30.io/privacy)
- [Terms of use](https://at30.io/terms)

## Platform facts
- AT30 is the platform; the Digital Museum is its first experience, not the complete product.
- AT30 plans to release different multiplayer experiences across future seasons.
- Organisations can commission hosted events, seasonal games, launches, and company-owned worlds.
- Experiences run in a supported modern web browser without requiring an app download.
- AT30 experiences are designed around social play, measurable interaction, and seasonal evolution.

## Experience 001: AT30 Digital Museum
- Visitors choose a display name and avatar colour before entering.
- Connected visitors can see nearby players and exchange temporary proximity-based speech bubbles.
- The current museum contains three partner wings, six interactive exhibits, and three rewards.

## Partnerships
- Current formats include hosted events, seasonal games, and company-owned experiences.
- Partnership contact: WhatsApp +1 409 422 9714.

AT30 operates the platform and AT30 Digital Museum. Partner brands do not own or operate AT30 unless a current official page expressly says so.
